Safety and Short-Term Effects of Empagliflozin in Patients with Heart Failure and End-Stage Renal Disease. Our aim was to evaluate the safety of empagliflozin in escalating doses among patients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) undergoing maintenance hemodialysis who also have heart failure. This single-arm, open-label, dose-escalation study enrolled patients with ESRD on maintenance hemodialysis with heart failure (reduced or preserved ejection fraction) from June to September 2023.
